decision_maker.name: T. Sean Adams
decision_maker.title: Executive Director
decision_maker.background: Former Ashtabula City Manager (2016-2023). Appointed AMHA Executive Director Feb 2024. Deep operational and municipal budget experience. Responds to efficiency and compliance arguments.
decision_maker.role_in_decision: Primary decision-maker — ED has authority to sign contracts under $25K without board approval under HUD sole-source rules.

secondary_contacts.name: Mary Church
secondary_contacts.title: Assistant Director, Planning & Community Development
secondary_contacts.note: City PCD — cross-over stakeholder for housing/community development alignment

organization_structure.mission: Provide Ashtabula County residents clean and safe affordable housing while keeping landlord communication responsive and program-ready.

pain_points: Paper-based repair request tracking across multiple programs
Inefficient landlord communication — phone tag and voicemail
Inspection scheduling bottlenecks delaying voucher readiness
No centralized digital record of maintenance requests and resolutions
Staff time consumed by manual follow-up instead of program management

pricing.pilot: Free 30-60 day hosted pilot — no infrastructure cost, no IT burden
pricing.annual_subscription: $5,000 - $15,000/year depending on modules and support tier
pricing.hud_compliance: Under $25K fits HUD sole-source procurement rules — can use Capital Fund or admin fee reserves

differentiators: Zero deployment overhead — already live at https://new-ashtabula-initiative.com/landlord/
No staff training required — intuitive web interface
Fallback code paths work without API keys — 100% uptime resilience
Landlord-facing portal reduces support call volume to AMHA staff

research_source: Honcho context synthesis from prior NAI sales tasks, coordination-sales.md, landing page review via vision analysis
